label: PRE-TIGHTENING / HISTORICAL
purpose: matched before-state for an upcoming strictness tightening of the compat-envelope comparison contract; measured hours (not days) before the after-state, on the same host, corpus and backend matrix

provenance.reverie_pin_note: the Reverie checkout and the git rev Cargo.lock links resolve independently in general; here they are equal, so the measured binary and the recorded reverie_sha agree
provenance.build: cargo build --release --locked -p hermit --features third-party-backends, after make install-deps; CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=1
provenance.run_utc_note: collect-fullcorpus.sh stamps ONE sweep-start epoch on every row, so run_utc is a sweep identity, not a per-cell timestamp; the window above is the sweep start stamp and the mtime of the emitted CSV

comparison_contract.verify_compare_derivation: the collector builds every Hermit argv in one place (build_hermit_argv) and never passes --verify-strict, so the --verify leg selects the default Stripped comparator; the column is a recorded constant for this sweep, not a per-row measurement
comparison_contract.det_argv_template: hermit [--backend B] run --strict --verify [--no-virtualize-cpuid --max-timeslice=disabled if lane=portable] --base-env minimal -e LC_ALL=C -e TZ=UTC -- <guest>
comparison_contract.parity_reference_argv_template: hermit run --strict [lane flags] --base-env minimal -e LC_ALL=C -e TZ=UTC -- <guest>   (plain --strict, ptrace, NOT --verify)
comparison_contract.deterministic_means: the --verify leg exited 0 under the stripped comparator (run1 == run2 after normalization)
comparison_contract.stdout_parity_means: sha256(backend plain --strict piped guest stdout) == sha256(ptrace plain --strict piped guest stdout)
not_established: INFO log, stack detlog, heap detlog comparison

denominators.denominator_rule: a non-ptrace backend percentage is a fraction of the ptrace cells that themselves passed the golden --strict --verify leg; cells where ptrace did not pass are excluded from every backend percentage

ratchet.verdict: the collector's per-backend det floors are NOT satisfiable on this corpus and must not be read as regressions
ratchet.reason: the floors are absolute cell counts calibrated on a 235-cell corpus; only 205 cells are buildable at this Hermit SHA, so ptrace (floor 214) and e9patch (floor 214) exceed the number of cells that can even run

host_load.coverage: 212 in-window samples spanning 2026-08-07T02:54:28Z-2026-08-07T03:47:25Z, i.e. the last ~53 of the 90 minute sweep; sampling started after the sweep did
host_load.contention_note: the box is shared with ~18 agents and carried a second, independent collect-fullcorpus.sh sweep concurrently with this one; duration_ms and max_rss_kb in the CSV are contended and are not benchmark-grade

changes_applied_to_scorecard_csv: run_id rewritten from the collector's generic literal 'fullcorpus' to 'pre-tightening-baseline-20260806' so these rows are self-identifying and cannot collide with the 2026-08-01 '*-fullcorpus-scorecard' run_ids under the renderer's last-writer-wins --all resolution
appended a 20th column verify_compare='stripped' so the certification tier travels with every row (the 19-column fullcorpus schema has no field in which a comparator can be recorded)
post_processing.no_other_changes: no row was added, removed, reordered or otherwise edited

reproduce_command:
HERMIT_REPO=<hermit checkout> REVERIE_REPO=<reverie checkout> HERMIT_BIN=<hermit>/target/release/hermit \
  compat-envelope/collect-fullcorpus.sh --backends ptrace,dbi,sabre,e9patch,liteinst \
  --par 16 --no-assert --out <out>.csv
